The characteristic polynomial of the matrix is given by the determinant of $(A - \lambda I)$, where $A$ is the given matrix, $\lambda$ is a scalar, and $I$ is the identity matrix of the same dimension. 

So we first construct the matrix $A - \lambda I = \left(\begin{array}{ccc}
-4-\lambda & -13 & 10 \\
-9 & 10-\lambda & 4 \\
12 & -5 & -14-\lambda
\end{array}\right)$.

The determinant of a $3 \times 3$ matrix $\left(\begin{array}{ccc}
a & b & c \\
d & e & f \\
g & h & i
\end{array}\right)$ can be computed as $a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg)$.

Applying this formula to our matrix $A - \lambda I$, we get the characteristic polynomial as $\lambda^3 + 8\lambda^2 + 53\lambda - 4$.

Hence, the characteristic polynomial of the given matrix $\boxed{\lambda^3 + 8\lambda^2 + 53\lambda - 4 }$.
